metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Chongqing, China increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Two time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 vs Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Chongqing, China (approximately 29.5°N, 106.5°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value) to filter valid NO2 measurements - qa_value > 0.75 is typically used for good quality data 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: NO2 can legitimately be near zero (clean air) - C1: No images found in collections - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: April-May > February (increase) - B: April-May <= February (no increase) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Chongqing area const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5, 29.5]).buffer(50000); // Time periods const period1_start = '2020-02-10'; const period1_end = '2020-02-26'; const period2_start = '2020-04-20'; const period2_end = '2020-05-13'; // Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterBounds(chongqing) .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterBounds(chongqing) .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each period const mean1 = col1.mean(); const mean2 = col2.mean(); // Get statistics with pixel count const stats1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chongqing, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chongqing, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const val2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Feb NO2: ${val1}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Apr-May NO2: ${val2}, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (val1 === null || val1 === undefined || val2 === null || val2 === undefined || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare values (NO2 in mol/m²) console.log(`Change: ${((val2 - val1) / val1 * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (val2 > val1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
